entries.7939e4d8bd37f434: It develops and manufactures electronic components, and sells them to set manufacturers (companies that make equipment) in Japan and overseas and to group sales companies to earn net sales. TAIYO YUDEN CO., LTD. supplies raw materials and semifinished products to manufacturing affiliates in Japan and overseas, the manufacturing affiliates process them into finished products and return them within the group, and the parent and sales companies sell them to set manufacturers. This company has no reporting [[term:segment|segment]] divisions. The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states, “Because it is a single segment, the electronic components business, no information is presented in association with segment information,” and there is only one business. Instead, the annual securities report divides net sales into 4 product categories — capacitors, inductors, composite devices and others — and net sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were capacitors ¥251,771 million, inductors ¥64,319 million, others ¥24,453 million, composite devices ¥14,796 million, for a total of ¥355,341 million. Capacitors alone account for about 7-tenths of the total.

entries.c0af8916f542307c: This business manufactures and sells electronic components such as capacitors, inductors and composite devices. This is the only business of the TAIYO YUDEN Group, and the securities report states: "Since the company has a single segment, the electronic components business, no description related to segment information is provided." TAIYO YUDEN CO., LTD. and manufacturing-related affiliates process products into finished goods, which are sold through sales-related affiliates to set manufacturers and others in Japan and overseas; the company also supplies raw materials and semi-finished products to manufacturing-related affiliates. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥355,341 million (up 4.1% year on year), and operating profit was ¥19,996 million (up 91.2%). The company attributes this to higher sales in automotive and information infrastructure and industrial equipment applications.
entries.c451844504c1ed25: Its main products are multilayer ceramic capacitors that store electricity, inductors that regulate the flow of electricity, communication devices (FBAR/SAW) that sort radio waves and circuit modules, and aluminum electrolytic capacitors made by its consolidated subsidiary Elna Co., Ltd. Production results in the fiscal year ended March 2026 (calculated at the average selling price during the period) were ¥254,843 million for capacitors, ¥65,441 million for inductors, ¥27,039 million for other and ¥12,481 million for composite devices, for a total of ¥359,806 million, up 6.4% from the previous fiscal year. The company explains that it develops from materials and creates high value-added, high-quality products by leveraging its strength of high technological capability.
entries.c8156ea74f644f38: Consolidated net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥355,341 million, up 4.1% from the previous fiscal year.
